name: tensioner-frame
title: Tensioner: the frame
description: A skeleton frame: a spine along the three shafts, a boss round each pin (printed standing, the gears turn on them), two feet across, and a branch out to the post the pawl stands on.

start.rule: Behind the crank's pinion (11.9 mm tips)

mid_x.rule: The middle shaft: m (17 + 34) / 2 from the crank

post_x.rule: The pawl's post under its root, just outside the spool gear's tips (35 mm from its shaft)

post.rule: Square: the pawl's 50 N at its top bends it to under 3 MPa

base.rule: The spine and feet, four millimetres

spine.rule: The spine along the shafts: as wide as a boss

boss.rule: Round each pin, deep enough to hold it upright

foot.rule: The feet across: wide enough that a crank's pull doesn't tip it

pin.rule: The shafts, printed with the frame: 6 mm keeps the crank's pin under 7 MPa

crank_pin.rule: Up the crank's tube to just under its arm

mid_pin.rule: Up through the middle shaft's two gears

out_pin.rule: Up through the spool shaft's gear, ratchet and spool
